notes.title: CrossPlanet Update 1.0!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone, we've been paying close attention to those of you trying the game, and have decided to release little update that fixes a couple of bugs and adds some nice quality of life features to the game. 
[/p][p]Additionally, we now have a ⁠looking-for-game channel, and an @ LFG ping in our Discord server, you can assign yourself this role via the ⁠Channels & Roles tab. As for the game updates, in short (view image for more in depth explanation) [/p][list][*][p]Locked/ private lobby feature added,[/p][/*][*][p]Progression system has additional levels with better rewards,[/p][/*][*][p]Menu will now have a provide feedback button,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the rocket launcher effects,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where using the in game text chat prevented users from exiting[/p][/*][*][p]Added Terms of Service/ Privacy Policy document at account creation[/p][/*][/list][p]We also take part in Steam's Third Person Shooter Fest later today, which should bring new eyeballs to the game! I encourage you to leave a review if you like the little project we've made too, it really helps us get discovered! Thank you! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/15f8b00e2a675e18fd2a3ce1263f26ba28c2acf2.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: CrossPlanet Releases TOMORROW! August 22nd + We're almost at 6000 Wishlists!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! [b]CrossPlanet officially launches tomorrow, August 22nd 2025[/b]. As many of you know, this isn't the launch we intended when we set out to make this game, but we're still super excited to see how many of you try the game that we produced as a team with 0 experience and no budget! 

We believe we've created something that has a solid foundation, and that it should be shared with the world even if it may never be fully polished and content complete. 

And, in the off-chance that there's a surge of players who are requesting us to continue, providing feedback and suggestions, then who knows, maybe we'll stick it out and provide monthly updates! [/p][p][/p][p]Hop into the world of CrossPlanet any time in August post-launch, and you'll have a chance to win exclusive in-game cosmetics too! We'll be gifting random users weapon skins, armor sets, armor paint, and player banners. Plus, play with devs! (Join our Discord to chat with them too) 

See you all in the arena! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/9167a3c38395f5d2a1700d3a76e88feb277514ea.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: CrossPlanet Launches August 22nd!
notes.notes:
[p]After over four years of work, we're finally ready to share what we've built. Steam has officially approved CrossPlanet, and it will release on [b]August 22nd[/b], along with being featured in Steam's "TPS Fest" on August 25th. 

This is not a "finished" game in the traditional sense. The project became far too big for our tiny team to complete without serious funding or a huge influx of volunteers. But instead of shelving it or letting it disappear, we've decided to release everything we've built, completely free. [/p][list][*][p][i]No price tag,[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]No microtransactions,[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]No shutdown,[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Once released, CrossPlanet will stay online and available for anyone to play. What you’ll get is a raw, skill-based multiplayer shooter, built with passion, even if it didn’t reach every goal we set out for. We’ve done everything we can to make sure it can live on, and we’re proud to finally let it out into the world. Thank you all for sticking with us, supporting us, and being part of this journey. 

Upon launching the game for the first time, you'll be met with a message about our journey and why we came to this decision, and we hope to see many of you there for a huge sendoff event! 

[b]August 22nd. Let’s go. 
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/c5651f551173a99378c079a52403c1b080ef0f7e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/78c54d89e9f693929c60a69972ab96d8421e357a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/4aeeddeb9b92a0fba27616d75886ecc6108f3551.jpg"][/img]
[/p]

notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a while! After releasing our demo, we received a ton of feedback regarding graphics, mechanics, weapon tuning, maps, and general game direction, so we've made some changes quietly behind the scenes, and our new trailer showcases what we've been working on and adding to CrossPlanet! 

[b]See the new trailer below, and leave a like plus comment to show support![/b]

notes.title: Playtest March 2nd/3rd!
notes.notes:
It's time for another CrossPlanet Playtest! We'll be doing these more frequently this year so that your feedback is heard loud and clear, and you can help shape CrossPlanet! 

New stuff includes: 

- XP System and Level Up/ Progression With Rewards!
- Bug Fixes/ Improvements! 
- New Mode "Capture The Flag" 
- New Mode "Husky Raid" 
- New Mode "CTF 1-Flag"
- New Map "Shelter"
- "Delta Station" Map Remade
- "Pipeline" Map Returns

The test will be for 24 hours, and will use custom games only this time around. We'd like more personal and individual feedback, so putting more emphasis on playing in your own time vs bots or a small group of players, rather than using matchmaking to get big matches. 

[previewyoutube=icAqEBwFKbw;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/428c3f61461c63cc12285eebd70c769a9c04efba.png[/img]

notes.title: CrossPlanet Playtest December 16-17th!
notes.notes:
[b]CrossPlanet is back one more time before we head into the new year! [/b]

Since our last test, we've made significant performance and optimisation improvements across the game, and our minimum specs have now been reduced, meaning more people can experience CrossPlanet. 

In addition to this, 2 new maps have been added to the game, which you can see in our newest trailer/ playtest announcement video on our Steam page, socials, and YouTube. 

We've also added 2 new game modes: SWAT and VIP. 

Finally, we fixed a ton of bugs we found previously so that the game is more stable than ever before, and we encourage you to help us find any remaining bugs as we head into our Early Access launch year! 

Make sure to join our Discord for constant updates, chat to the community in text or voice chats while playing the playtest, and access to exclusive giveaways such as armor, skins, and banners. 

[b]Discord: https://discord.com/invite/wRkCcNEYek[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41793492/646281c0a8d99497583f89b3787a0b7ebe417604.jpg[/img]
